text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 latency breach detected for /v1/generate (hosted-prod). Current p95=820ms (SLO 350ms), p99=2.6s. Spike correlates with tokenizer/preproc stage. Paging oncall.
priya (oncall): I'm on it. pinging infra and ML. Any obvious deploys in last 15m?
kevin: No infra deploys. There's a small release to tool-schema-service 12m ago but not infra. Adding metrics: tokenization time p95 went from 40ms->400ms; preproc (prompt rendering + validation) p95 300ms->1.1s.
daniel: seeing elevated CPU on preproc workers for JSON-mode parsing. Error rates are not up, just processing time per request. Correlation with requests using tool_schema v3 (new optional tool descriptions).
priya (oncall): Rachel, any customer reports?
rachel (support): One customer (acme-marketing) reported streaming spinner for >20s on certain long-tool traces. No full failures, just long stalls. Support has a ticket open.
kevin: Can reproduce locally with a synthetic prompt that includes heavy nested tool schemas + JSON output modes. When JSON-mode=true we do full strict validation which triggers expensive recursion in the preproc renderer.
daniel: digging in profiler. Key hotspot: prompt_template.render() -> validate_json_schema() -> schema_resolver.resolve_all() which is O(n^2) on number of tool properties for our current naive resolver.
maya: looping in. Oncall handover in 5m, I'll take lead after that.
priya (oncall): handing to maya for mitigation — I'm going offline in 10. Maya, are you ok taking it?
maya: taking it now. Plan: 1) roll a hotfix gate to skip strict JSON validation for streaming endpoints for 30m 2) increase preproc concurrency for tokens pipeline 3) monitor p95.
maya: quick config to gate validation — will patch via feature-flag: prompt.strict_json_validation=false for /v1/generate-streaming. Patch:
```
# feature flags
prompts.strict_json_validation: true -> false
routes./v1/generate.streaming.strict_json_validation: false
```
maya: preparing a tiny change and will push to canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: maya/jsonmode-skip-validation -> canary (2 instances)
kevin: also add a catcher to short-circuit schema_resolver for deep schemas: `if depth>8 return lightweight-resolve` — low risk.
maya: applied patch to canary, toggled flag. canary metrics: tokenization p95 down from 820ms -> 240ms on canary instances. Streaming tail improved, no stalls observed on canary in last 2m.
priya (oncall): nice. roll to prod but keep rollback ready.
maya: rolling to prod subset (10% traffic) now.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: maya/jsonmode-skip-validation -> prod (10%)
kevin: watching metrics. p95 system-wide now 360ms and trending down. p99 at 1.2s.
rachel (support): I've updated acme-marketing that we're rolling a mitigation and asking for reproduction traces if they still see stalls.
daniel: note — this is a workaround. Root cause: schema resolver algorithm. We'll need a proper fix: memoization + iterative resolver.
maya: agreed. Creating follow-up issue with priority-high. Also add a regression test for large tool schemas and JSON-mode streaming.
maya: follow-up TODOs in ticket:
- refactor schema_resolver to O(n) with memoization
- add unit + perf tests for nested tool schemas
- add opt-in bypass flag parsing for streaming vs blocking endpoints
- postmortem writeup
priya (oncall): good work. Any customer-visible SLO breaches to report to account teams?
rachel (support): We should inform account teams for customers who were above our SLA threshold — acme-marketing and two others saw 5-15% latency regression; one had streaming stall. I'll compile affected request ids from logs.
kevin: adding timeline notes: started ~1943212200, detected alert 1943212345, mitigation in canary 1943212600, prod partial rollout 1943212900, full rollback not needed. closing the pager once p95 stays <400ms for 15m.
maya: leaving a short blameless postmortem draft in #postmortems after stabilization. I'll own follow-ups. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by maya. Pager silenced.
